title: InvoiceIssueRequest
description: The input of invoice.issue: the invoice's canonical URI, and the version of that invoice its caller decided on (step 21's README, decisions 4 and 5). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names it and does not define it (step 07's README, decision 2).

expected_version.description: The version of the invoice that the caller read, and decided on. §38 names expected_version an argument of a tool (step 21's README, decisions 3 to 5). At most 2147483647, the largest version the database's integer column holds (step 21's README, decision 10).
